mechanism: Decomposed Estimation: break unknown quantity into factors you can {{estimate}}. Multiply factors. Accept order-of-magnitude accuracy. Example: "pianos in Chicago" = population × household fraction × piano-owning fraction. Errors often cancel across factors. It invokes {{decompose}} to break an unknown quantity into estimable sub-factors.
failure_modes: Correlated Error Stacking: If all sub-estimates are biased in the same direction (e.g., all optimistic), the errors compound rather than cancel.
invariants: Error Cancellation: Overestimation in sub-factors tends to cancel underestimation
Geometric Mean: Final estimate is geometric mean of bounds
